_readme: Optional real recordings. Put files in public/audio/ and write their file names here. Empty entries = synthesized sound is used (or, for the voice lines, the step is skipped). welcome / intro_* = the owner's welcome and his introductions of everyone around the fire (see src/game/intro/introScript.js); scenario_intro = the narrator introducing scenario 1 over a shot of everyone at the fire, at the end of the introductions. ghost_boo / ghost_giggle / scream_<owner|amir|alireza|amin> = scenario 1 (the sheet ghost), synthesized when empty. amir_party / farajpour_thanks / farajpour_pickles = lines of errand 1 (shown as captions when empty). ghost_laugh_scary / ghost_whisper / luna_bark = the haunted walk back (the scary ghost's deep laugh, its whisper, Luna barking at the dark), synthesized when empty.
